strings: As whitecough season comes around again, r_c0 notices that m_c is one of the first in the Clan who's unfortunate enough to catch it.
With a bit of frustration, m_c slinks off to the medicine den to get some help with the bout of whitecough that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} caught.
Unfortunately, due to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} rash, m_c's a bit more susceptible to whitecough when it comes around the Clan.
